sources.title: Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit Carrier Board Specification
sources.claim: The companion board interfaces to the developer kit, not directly to the 260-pin module connector; use the developer-kit DC input path.

sources.title: Jetson Orin NX and Orin Nano Series Thermal Design Guide
sources.claim: Thermal integration must be validated at the selected module power mode with the production enclosure closed.

sources.title: Jetson Orin Nano downloads and current product documentation
sources.claim: 15 W and 25 W operating cases are required; a conservative 40 W MAXN envelope is retained for Super-mode screening.

sources.title: CH32V307 product page
sources.claim: CH32V307 uses the QingKe V4F core and operates up to 144 MHz; exact package and pin mux remain an AVL and schematic-release decision.

sources.title: ISO1042 isolated CAN transceiver
sources.claim: CAN FD up to 5 Mbps, 5 kVrms isolation, and 70 V bus-fault protection are supported by the selected transceiver family; the DW high-voltage land pattern provides 8.1 mm board-copper clearance between pad rows.

sources.title: MEJ1S0305SC 1 W isolated DC-DC converter
sources.claim: The candidate is production-tested at 5.2 kVDC but specifies 2 mm creepage/clearance and 200 Vrms working voltage; it cannot close an 8 mm reinforced system-isolation claim without safety and vendor review.

sources.title: LTC4368 100 V UV/OV and reverse protection controller Rev. C
sources.claim: The selected -2 option supports 100 V input protection, external back-to-back N-channel MOSFETs, and bidirectional current-fault sensing; the detailed design uses the documented MSOP-10 pinout.

sources.title: BSC093N15NS5 OptiMOS 5 150 V MOSFET
sources.claim: The MOSFET candidate is a 150 V PG-TDSON-8 device; pins 1-3 are source, pin 4 is gate, and the repeated pad 5 is drain.

sources.title: DCM3623T50M31C2T00 official datasheet (exclusion evidence)
sources.claim: The official datasheet specifies a 16-50 V input range, 28 V output and nine-terminal through-hole ChiP package. DCM3623T50M31C2T00 is excluded because it cannot satisfy the required 36-60 V input and regulated 12 V output; this source is not candidate evidence.

sources.title: TPS2663x 60 V 6 A industrial eFuse
sources.claim: TPS26633 is the candidate protected 12 V Jetson branch device; current limit, thermal behavior and the exposed-pad land pattern require loaded validation.

sources.title: RPL-5.0 5 A buck regulator module
sources.claim: RPL-5.0 is the 5 A logic-rail candidate; final pinout, output programming, land pattern and thermal limits require datasheet and vendor drawing closure.

sources.title: SFM force-guided relay family
sources.claim: SFM4-DC12V is a force-guided relay candidate only; exact contact numbering, footprint, diagnostic coverage and safety suitability require vendor drawing and safety-owner approval.

controlled_assumptions.envelope: 12 V, 120 W maximum aggregate at J2
150 x 72 mm mechanical opening; power and data connector undefined
36-60 V input, regulated 12 V, 240 W class
dual-channel E-stop, independent gated motor-enable output, 1 ms disable target
